notes: Captions only. The -1/-2/-3 loading levels and the reason -2 was carried to devices are not in any caption, so the sweep ends at -2 without a down_select node. Caption F1b prints 'RCO-Cu2S-7' (OCR of RGO-Cu2S-1); F4c caption reverses the sample name (Cu2S-RGO-2). F4c panel labels Cu 2p1/2 and 2p3/2 swapped. CV (F6a) does not separate RGO-Cu2S from Cu2S (audit q16); the ranking rests on EIS and Tafel. No PCE is shown in any figure.
